description: This file defines an internal partial class 'AdoNetQueueAdapter' that implements 'IQueueAdapter' for interacting with a queue via ADO.NET providers within Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes constructor initialization, properties, methods for creating receivers, queuing message batches asynchronously, and logging functionality.

classes.name: AdoNetQueueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for queue operations using ADO.NET within Orleans streaming, providing message queuing and receiver creation functionalities.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a queue receiver for the specified QueueId, mapping it to the ADO.NET queue identifier.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of messages onto the stream, handling serialization and exceptions.

methods.name: LogFailedToQueueStreamMessage
methods.description: Logs an error when message queuing fails, with details about the exception and queue identifiers.
